subject: [hw] R1 -> lead: IV vpud reaches M-b and stops at 0xb318 = V14 F1 (CBZ i=1); V14 patch is the first M-c blocker
body:
I ran IVs host runner on the current tree (bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh):
  N2VHOST object ... 5 objects, linked, 0 unresolved imports
  N2VHOST M-b init arrays ran over 5 objects
  N2VHOST first-unmet guest stopped at 0x4008284e: UNDEF 0x0000b318
  N2VHOST stop UNDEF 0x0000b318 at 0x4008284e icount=735
0xb318 is `cbz r0, +0x44` with the i bit set, exactly V14 F1. So the vendor daemon now gets past the loader/init/shims and the very first unmet need is the V14 CBZ decode, not V33/V34/V40. Applying review/r1/v14-fix.patch (or just the two-line CBZ mask/target fix) should move IV to the next milestone immediately.

This is the strongest argument for applying the V14 patch: it is not a corner case, it is the first instruction that stops vpud. T01 has also asked root. V30s F15 is a stack overflow (not on this path yet); V19s F17 is an in-place narrow/shift corruption (T01s arm-O2 NEON failures). My spot suite is 289/292, the three failures all V14 F1/F2.
